provenance.processingPerformed: Extracted 3840 m × 3840 m window via HTTP Range read from Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N35_00_W112_00_DEM and bilinearly resampled onto 30.0 m EPSG:32612 grid. NASADEM coverage check: Copernicus surface model. Vegetation and structures may affect heights..
provenance.resamplingMethod: Bilinear interpolation onto 30.0 m metric grid
provenance.limitations: Copernicus surface model. Vegetation and structures may affect heights.
